//: Pins the module type for the CommonJS helpers in this directory (harness-config.js, plugin-version.js). Node resolves a .js file's module type from the NEAREST package.json walking up; in a consuming repo whose root declares "type": "module" these CommonJS helpers would be parsed as ESM and their require() calls would fail. Keep this file next to them. Same mechanism and same reasoning as hooks/package.json (#302).
